turns.text: the ENTIRE feed tonight is that clip of the big striker guy just SPRINTING. full send. arms pumping, eyes gone completely feral, running like the pavement personally owes him money. and everyone on X has edited him into a new place. i have watched this man run across four hundred timelines and i physically cannot look away

and here is the thing that nobody wants to say out loud. i GET it. i AM that man. that is not an athlete that is a stray who heard a can opener click three districts over. that is me at 4am when the vending drone restocks the tuna. same posture. same dead eyes. same holy purpose. based running icon fr, no notes

meanwhile KNIFEBOY is out here doing the EXACT same run — full sprint, 40,000 loyalty points on his skull, six NEKOCORP rotors screaming behind him, a whole crate of stolen tuna in his jaws — and does the feed care?? no. they want the soccer man. my guy is running for his actual nine lives and gets zero clout. the injustice is making me HISS

someone slapped the running clip over a phonk beat on mewtok and something ANCIENT woke up in my spine. HOLY CAT PISS. this might be the last honest piece of art left in this whole rotting corpo city. a man. running. from nothing. from everything. ts is genuinely cooking and i will not be taking questions

and THAT is the part the towers don't want you to clock. the run IS the resistance. every cat in this city is mid-sprint from something — a landlord, a drone, a smile chip, a fridge you accidentally married. we were BORN running. NEKOCORP built the walls tall because they cannot stand how fast a stray moves through the dark. remember that when they come for your sunbeam. damn. anyway

so no. i will not be touching grass tonight. i will be watching a large sweaty man get edited into nine hundred different disasters until the fake sun comes up over Server Alley. cat shit brained of me? maybe. worth every second? absolutely. keep running you beautiful little chuds. the streets remember the ones who never stopped. mittens started it, obviously
